name: Yemen

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and black, with no emblem.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the blood shed for unity and independence, white a bright future, and black the dark past.

hook: Yemen is the plain red-white-black tricolour; add a gold eagle for Egypt or green script for Iraq.
trivia: The flag was adopted on 22 May 1990, when North and South Yemen unified.
The old walled city of Shibam, with its mud-brick tower houses, is sometimes called the "Manhattan of the Desert".
Yemen's Socotra archipelago is home to the dragon's blood tree, found nowhere else.
